entries.content: Health-check design rule: a monitoring check must distinguish 'I could not measure this' from 'this is broken'. model-manager.mjs now has an 'unmonitored' status for providers with no HEALTH_ENDPOINTS entry — it is logged loudly (console + provider-unmonitored ledger event) but never latches down, never swaps an agent's model, and never fires highSeverityFailure. Same failure class as egress-preflight REQ-006. Any new provider added to budget.json must ship with a probe; tests/adapter-and-model-manager.test.mjs enforces this.

Environment lesson (2026-08-01): systemd user units do NOT inherit an interactive shell's environment. GROQ_API_KEY was exported from ~/.bashrc, so an interactive 'model-manager.mjs check' showed 'groq: up' while the scheduler journal showed 'groq: not configured' on every tick. ALWAYS verify scheduler-affecting config from 'journalctl --user -u <unit>' after a real timer run, never from an interactive shell — an interactive run is what hid this. Scheduler-visible secrets belong in ~/.hermes/.env (mode 0600), which every sdlc-sched-* unit loads via EnvironmentFile=-%h/.hermes/.env.
